outline: 介紹高分子材料的分類、結構、性質、測試與分析方法，並探討高分子之聚合反應、聚合方法、反應機構、反應動力學、熱力學..等技術。
schedule:
週次   單元主題
1.     Introduction of polymer chemistry
2.     The morphology and properties of polymers
3-4.   Molecular weight and polymer solutions
5.     The testing and analysis of polymers
6-7    Condensation and step polymerization
8.     Free-radical polymerization
9.     Midterm exam
10.    Ionic and coordination polymerization
11.    Copolymerization
12.    Other polymerization
13.    Reactions of polymers and method of polymerization
14.    Biomedical application of natural and synthetic polymers
15-17  Final oral presentations
18.    Final exam
assessment: 期中考: 30% ; 期末考: 40% ; 期末報告及平時表現: 30%
